mapper.select: SELECT task_id, task_max_concurrency, version, create_time, update_time FROM ifj_task_concurrency_policy WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ifj_task_concurrency_policy (task_id, task_max_concurrency, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{taskMaxConcurrency}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
INSERT INTO ifj_task_concurrency_resource (task_id, resource_id, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{resourceId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.version, r.code, r.name, r.max_concurrency, r.enabled, r.description, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM ifj_task_concurrency_resource tr JOIN ifj_concurrency_resource r ON r.id=tr.resource_id WHERE tr.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY r.id
